enemies.name: Infected Patrol Captain
enemies.flavour_text: An officer tasked with hunting the Infected of Ursus. Greedy and cold-blooded.

abilities.text: Can use long-ranged weapons to attack <Ursus Civilians> and <Talulah, the Fighter>

enemies.name: Elite Infected Patrol Captain
enemies.flavour_text: A high-ranking officer tasked with hunting the Infected of Ursus. Greedy and cold-blooded. They are not a part of the army, and are generally despised by Ursus soldiers and city officials alike.

abilities.text: Can use long-ranged weapons to attack <Ursus Civilians> and <Talulah, the Fighter>

enemies.name: Ursus Mangler
enemies.flavour_text: A warbeast trained by the Ursus Army. Obedient and relentless, they tear through armor with ease to sate their thirst for flesh and blood.

enemies.name: Ursus Mangler Packmother
enemies.flavour_text: A warbeast pack leader trained by the Ursus Army. Obedient and relentless, they tear through armor with ease to sate their thirst for flesh and blood. Nobody has ever seen a male mangler.

enemies.name: Ursus Assault Crossbowman
enemies.flavour_text: An Ursus soldier who is proficient at infiltrating deep into enemy territory. Equipped with a powerful heavy-duty crossbow.

abilities.text: Able to land directly onto the battlefield.

enemies.name: Ursus Armored Caster
enemies.flavour_text: A basic caster in the Ursus Army. Clad in simple armor.

enemies.name: Elite Ursus Armored Caster
enemies.flavour_text: A basic caster in the Ursus Army who has displayed excellence. They are clad in armor and wield more powerful Arts.

enemies.name: Ursus Raider
enemies.flavour_text: Special forces within the Ursus Army that strike a balance between mobility and breakthrough capabilities. Good at fighting underequipped enemy forces.

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by units with at least 2 Block
Can use long-ranged weapons to attack <Ursus Civilians> and <Talulah, the Fighter>

enemies.name: Ursus Raider Leader
enemies.flavour_text: Captains within the Ursus Army that strike a balance between mobility and breakthrough capabilities, equipped with higher-quality armor. Good at fighting underequipped enemy forces.

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by units with at least 2 Block
Can use long-ranged weapons to attack <Ursus Civilians> and <Talulah, the Fighter>

enemies.name: Imperial Artillery Targeteer
enemies.flavour_text: A heavily-armored, sturdily-built drone operated by artillery casters of the Ursus army. They presage the withering firepower of the Ursus Artillery.

abilities.text: Flying unit.

enemies.name: Imperial Artillery Core Targeteer
enemies.flavour_text: A heavily-armored, sturdily-built core drone operated by artillery technicians of the Ursus army. They presage the withering firepower of the Ursus Artillery. The Ursus Artillery is a fire team that has bunkered down into the city. Though packing less firepower than naval guns, their equipment still shreds through buildings and armor with ease.

abilities.text: Flying unit.

enemies.name: Imperial Striker
enemies.flavour_text: The powerful infantry of the Ursus Army, the backbone of the Imperial Army's aggressive advance. They are versatile in offense and defense, melee and ranged. After sustain a certain amount of damage, their morale will peak, causing them to inflict more destruction.

abilities.text: Gains significantly increased ATK when HP is under 50%

enemies.name: Elite Imperial Striker
enemies.flavour_text: The powerful, battle-tested infantry of the Ursus Army, the backbone of the Imperial Army's aggressive advance. They are versatile in offense and defense, melee and ranged. After sustain a certain amount of damage, their morale will peak, causing them to inflict more destruction. Along with the Shieldguards, they formed the front line of the Ursus Army.

abilities.text: Gains significantly increased ATK when HP is under 50%

enemies.name: Sarkaz Centurion Host
enemies.flavour_text: A Sarkaz mercenary unwittingly converted into one of Mephisto's Herd, able to damage multiple targets at once and drain vitality from its victims. Prevents others from entering the Sarcophagus - do not push too far in, and you may yet avoid their wrath.

abilities.text: Attacks 3 enemies simultaneously
Restores a certain amount of HP after each attack, based upon damage dealt

enemies.name: Sarkaz Centurion Nidus Guard
enemies.flavour_text: A Sarkaz mercenary leader unwittingly converted into one of Mephisto's Herd, able to damage multiple targets at once and drain vitality from its victims. More ferociously prevents others from entering the Sarcophagus.

abilities.text: Attacks 3 enemies simultaneously
Restores a certain amount of HP after each attack, based upon damage dealt

enemies.name: 'Emperor's Blade'
enemies.flavour_text: A manifestation of a certain will in Ursus. The most terrifying military force in the entirety of Ursus, they are widely-known throughout the world only as horrifying spectres of legend and yore. A single one is enough to slaughter entire squads. Defeat has never been a possibility.

abilities.text: Cannot be attacked, will not deplete Life Points on leaving the field
Permanently applies [Weaken] to <Talulah, the Fighter> (Greatly reduces DEF and RES)

enemies.name: Talulah
enemies.flavour_text: The leader and spokesperson of Reunion. So far, she has been confirmed to have masterminded multiple riots, as well as the destruction of Chernobog.

abilities.text: [Stellar Corona] Deals Arts damage to all allied units within range
[Burning Breath] Causes an allied unit within attack range to take True damage that gradually increases (Deals increasing True damage each second, but can be Resisted)
Deals True damage when blocked
When HP drops below half, gains greatly increased DEF and RES and uses skills more often

enemies.name: Mephisto, 'The Singer'
enemies.flavour_text: You seem to recognize the mysterious, mythical beast that has descended from the Sarcophagus. An otherworldly song flows from its sharp beak and floods its surroundings. It seems to devour the will of the Infected around it, including its own. Even if it knows not what it is doing, its song does not cease. It simply wishes to sing.

abilities.text: Activated Form
When Activated, heals and strengthens an enemy Host unit
Each time a certain percentage of HP is lost, releases toxic dust across the entire battlefield that lasts for 30s and can stack
The first time HP drops to 0, enters a Dormant State for a period of time
Dormant State
Gains increased DEF and RES, and continuously recovers HP

enemies.name: 'Deathless Black Snake'
enemies.flavour_text: A disenchanted Reunion soldier, or a giant manipulating history? A conspirator full of lies, or a nobleman swallowed by tragedy? The truth has been turned to ash, and only an evil god stands in the flames.

abilities.text: First Phase
Attacks deal True damage and apply [Burning Breath] to the target (Deals increasing True damage each second, but can be Resisted)
Periodically applies [Burning Breath] to two allied units, and also greatly reduces damage taken from units afflicted with [Burning Breath]
Detonates all allied units on the field afflicted by [Burning Breath], dealing Arts damage to the surrounding four tiles and applying [Burning Breath] to targets hit by this splash effect
When HP drops to 0, releases [Deathless Inferno], dealing massive Arts damage across the battlefield and enters Enraged State
Enraged State
Max HP and ATK are greatly increased
Summons an <Energy Aggregate> to help in combat

enemies.name: Ursus Civilian
enemies.flavour_text: An ordinary Ursus citizen caught in the crossfire. A part of the cruelty and suffering of this world.

abilities.text: Does not deplete Life Points when spared, but will deplete a Life Point upon dying
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter

enemies.name: Talulah, the Fighter
enemies.flavour_text: The Infected warrior, Talulah. She will never look back.

abilities.text: Does not deduct Life Points when entering the enemy Incursion Point, but will instead deduct Life Points upon dying
Applies [Burning Breath] to an enemy within attack range (Deals increasing True damage each second, but can be Resisted)
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter
